message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No credible vulnerability newly reported or materially updated in the last 24 hours was confirmed as relevant to the normalized DLL/component inventory.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only. Duplicate names and obvious aliases were normalized; `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-19 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-20 07:40 UTC (2026-10-19 13:10 IST through 2026-10-20 13:10 IST).

### Findings

None.

### Possible matches needing review

None.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations and maintained libraries, MongoDB-owned alerts, CVE records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported or materially updated during the scan window. The newest security entries on the [MongoDB Alerts page](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) are dated October 13, 2026 and were excluded as stale.

### Source and freshness notes

The newest entries visible in the [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories?query=sort%3Apublished-desc) for October 19–20 did not match the listed components; the most recent visible NuGet and npm advisories predated the scan window. Oracle's [October 2026 Critical Patch Update](https://www.oracle.com/security-alerts/cpuoct2026.html) was still presented as a pre-release announcement published before the cutoff, so it was not treated as a new in-window finding.

### Review priority

No immediate vulnerability-driven action is indicated from this 24-hour scan. Continue routine monitoring, particularly for publication of Oracle's final October 2026 advisory and any subsequent MongoDB alert updates.
